result:
Order utilities for a shop backend: compute an order total, apply percentage discount codes (SAVE10/SAVE20), compute average item price, and format an order as text.

Bugs:
- `calcTotal` (test/orders.js:5): loop uses `i <= items.length`, reading one past the end — `items[i].price` throws TypeError on the undefined element (or yields NaN if it didn't crash). Should be `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` (test/orders.js:20): divides by zero for an empty array, returning NaN (and calcTotal crashes on empty input anyway due to the bug above).
- `formatOrder` (test/orders.js:26): if `total` were NaN the output is "Total: NaN"; also no guard for a missing `order.items`. Minor compared to the loop bug, which breaks every function since all depend on `calcTotal`.

The one real defect is the off-by-one in `calcTotal`; the others are unguarded edge cases.
